name: Creative Woodworks, Inc.
old_description: Creative Woodworks began with a couple who owned a small custom furniture and cabinetry shop, where the mother handled sales and design, and the husband managed fabrication. Jose and Jeremias, their sons, worked in the shop. Eager to advance their craft, Jose and Jeremias ventured into starting their own company. Fusing the art of furniture and cabinetry design and fabrication it became a decision that marked the start of their journey to becoming the renowned third-generation custom cabinetry company they are today.
about:
Creative Woodworks, Inc. was founded in 2001 in West Valley City, Utah, by Jose and Jeremias, the sons of a couple who ran a small custom furniture and cabinetry shop. The business remains family-owned, now spanning three generations of cabinetmaking experience.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs high-end custom cabinetry for luxury residences. Combining old-world craftsmanship with modern technology, Creative Woodworks has completed over 1,000 projects in its 24-plus years of operation. The shop handles detailed cabinet drawings, fabrication, and on-site installation, often collaborating closely with builders and designers throughout the process.

Primary customers include custom home builders such as Don Jones and Douglas Knight Construction, as well as interior designers like L. Ashton. Projects range from gourmet kitchens and bars to bathroom vanities and specialty pieces such as elaborate bunk beds, all tailored to high-end residential clients.

The founders emphasize that the company differentiates itself through the customer experience, not just the product. Rooted in principles taught by Jose’s mother—listening closely to client needs—the team aims to make every step from design to final touch-ups memorable. The family’s hands-on involvement and pride in craftsmanship are cited as key reasons clients return.
